notes: Variant SBLGNT.ROM.7.23.v006 selects r00-base over s005 (ἐν), which the ASV renders *in* here and notes as *Greek in* at the later occurrence (rule 12).

*against* is given to the dative phrase's article rather than kept inside ἀντιστρατευόμενον, following rule 106's oblique-object arm (ACT.4.1, ACT.4.3), the ASV having written *warring* as the compound's own verb word; rule 21 then puts the case preposition on the determiner-bearing article. Reading *against* as the preverb ἀντί's own particle under rule 106's main arm remains the competing analysis.
αἰχμαλωτίζοντά heads on *captivity*: no part of *bringing … into* glosses the lexeme, so rules 17 and 91 put the head on the meaning-bearing complement.
s023's second attributive article is `unrepresented` because a participle follows and carries the relativizer (rule 31), against s011's article which takes *the* as its noun's determiner.
Partition verified: s001–s028 and t001–t031 each appear exactly once.
